scope: POSIX owned-directory lifecycle, automatic persisted UUID/channel identity and native CLI composition; no image or live HA update
testFirst: The owned-storage behavioral suite first failed collection because its module did not exist; native owned-runtime tests first failed because the factory and CLI option did not exist.
assertions: An empty private directory receives one initializing UUID/channel marker, real SQLite schema and durable ready marker before HTTP; no household or membership is implicitly created
Restart preserves UUID, household and same-key original command result; native composition initializes storage exactly once, then uses existing-only mode on restart
A lifecycle lock excludes a concurrent process; close and abrupt process death release ownership
Actual child-process death before and after schema commit resumes only the durable initializing UUID
Failed ready-marker atomic replacement leaves a resumable original identity; owned abandoned staging is cleaned under lock
Ready metadata refuses missing, empty, corrupt or foreign SQLite without rewriting the original marker or database
Missing marker never adopts a preexisting database, sidecar or staged metadata; channel mismatch and invalid exact-field metadata fail closed
Private ownership, exact file/directory modes, no-follow opens, regular files and single links reject symlinks, hardlinks, FIFOs and shared files without altering external targets
Existing-only initialization still performs the explicit v1-to-v2 migration while preserving household, audit and outbox history
Configuration fails before persistent records; failed later runtime composition releases the directory lock; partial and competing CLI identity options are rejected
POSIX locking remains infrastructure-only and negative architecture fixtures reject fcntl in both domain and application
schema: Business schema 2 unchanged; separate version-1 initialization metadata contains only UUID/channel/state and no credentials
trustBoundary: POSIX filesystem, trusted operator-owned private directory and parents. Every process accessing these files must honor the protocol. No protection from the local owner or unauthorized manual path/metadata replacement is claimed.
installedPreview: Edge 0.0.0-edge.1 is unchanged, stateless and does not enable owned storage. Supervisor data-directory provisioning for the packaged runtime UID is not yet accepted.
remaining: Provision private /data child ownership in the HA package without running the server with excess privilege
Updated immutable app package and CPU-family/container/live acceptance
Product UI, console-approved recovery, consistent snapshot/restore and full M1
Complete standalone companion authority and both deployment/channel acceptance
